significance: Carlo Ginzburg's I Benandanti: Stregoneria e culti agrari tra Cinquecento e Seicento (Einaudi, Turin, 1966) — English translation: The Night Battles (1983) — established the microhistorical methodology for witch-trial scholarship and introduced the benandante material, founding the argument that a popular spirit-journey tradition underlay the composite sabbath stereotype.
source_method: Ginzburg, I Benandanti (Einaudi, 1966); English translation: Night Battles (Johns Hopkins University Press, 1983)
